name: Proton Pass
description: SPKI TLS cert-pinning for the proton.me update domain on top of Squirrel.Mac/MSIX code-signing. Strong transport, but payload trust rests on OS signing (B not A).
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The inspected Proton Pass desktop session pins proton.me and subdomains to configured SPKI SHA-256 hashes; Windows updates use a native MSIX path and macOS uses Electron autoUpdater. Artifact-signing enforcement remains unresolved.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout.
Native MSIX updater, Electron updater internals, artifacts, and signing configuration were not audited.
